'''Zoran Hadzibabic''' ({{langx|sr|Zoran Hadžibabić}}, born 1974) is a Serbian-British physicist and Professor of Physics at the [[University of Cambridge]]. He completed his PhD at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] in 2003 under the supervision of [[Wolfgang Ketterle]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Honors: Prof. Zoran Hadžibabić Awarded the Marko Jarić Prize |url=https://www.ipb.ac.rs/en/news/honors-prof-zoran-hadzibabic-awarded-the-marko-jaric-prize/ |publisher=Institute of Physics Belgrade |date=26 April 2022|access-date=27 May 2025}}</ref> Following postdoctoral research at the [[École Normale Supérieure]] in Paris, he joined the [[Cavendish Laboratory]] at Cambridge in 2007.<ref name="hp">{{cite web |title=Prof. Zoran Hadzibabic |url=https://www.phy.cam.ac.uk/profile/prof-zoran-hadzibabic/ |publisher=University of Cambridge |access-date=27 May 2025}}</ref>

In 2016, Hadzibabic received the [[Fernand Holweck Medal and Prize]] in recognition of his experiments on the control of ultracold quantum degenerate gases.<ref>{{cite web |title=Holweck Prize |url=https://www.amop.phy.cam.ac.uk/Holweck |publisher=University of Cambridge |access-date=27 May 2025}}</ref> He is a [[Fellow of the American Physical Society]].<ref name=hp />
